title: Runs stabilize after guaranteed halting
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose every choice word of length exactly $t$ leads to a halted configuration on $x$. Then for every choice word $w$ with $|w|\geq t$, running on $w$ gives the same configuration as running on the prefix of $w$ of length $t$.
